panels.title: Total estimated monthly cost
panels.description: Compute (CPU+RAM allocation × node hourly cost) projected to a month (×730h). Excludes network/LB/storage.

targets.expr: sum( (container_cpu_allocation * on(node) group_left() node_cpu_hourly_cost) + ((container_memory_allocation_bytes / 1024^3) * on(node) group_left() node_ram_hourly_cost) ) * 730

panels.title: Estimated monthly cost by team
panels.description: Team derived from the environment namespace prefix (<team>-<product>-<stage>). Compare against the Team's envelope.budget.monthlyUSD (platform $5000, alpha/bravo $2000).

targets.expr: sum by (team) ( label_replace( sum by (namespace) ( (container_cpu_allocation * on(node) group_left() node_cpu_hourly_cost) + ((container_memory_allocation_bytes / 1024^3) * on(node) group_left() node_ram_hourly_cost) ) * 730, "team", "$1", "namespace", "^([a-z0-9]+)-.*" ) )

sort_desc( sum by (namespace) ( (container_cpu_allocation * on(node) group_left() node_cpu_hourly_cost) + ((container_memory_allocation_bytes / 1024^3) * on(node) group_left() node_ram_hourly_cost) ) * 730 )

panels.title: Hourly compute cost rate by environment
panels.description: Live hourly cost rate (not projected). Sum across all environments ≈ the burn rate.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) ( (container_cpu_allocation * on(node) group_left() node_cpu_hourly_cost) + ((container_memory_allocation_bytes / 1024^3) * on(node) group_left() node_ram_hourly_cost) )
